note: Solidity=0.7 x Metal2=32 at reference blade

parameter_kind.Xthick: non-dimensional: chordwise fraction of maximum thickness
parameter_kind.Tmax: non-dimensional: maximum thickness ratio (legacy profile parameterisation)
parameter_kind.Metal2: deg: exit metal angle (Metal1 = 53 deg frozen in the geometry core)
parameter_kind.Solidity: non-dimensional: chord / pitch (changes ONLY the .geomTurbo periodicity, never the blade shape)
parameter_kind.Incidence: deg: operating condition, does not change the geometry
parameter_kind.Mach: non-dimensional: operating condition, does not change the geometry

duplicate_blade_group.note: cases sharing (Xthick, Tmax, Metal2) have the same single blade outline; they differ only in Solidity, i.e. in the periodicity of the .geomTurbo

geometry_generation.produced_by: code/02_generate_geometry.py (V2 run; not re-run for this package)

geometry_qc.produced_by: code/03_geometry_qc.py (V2 run; not re-run for this package)

min_gap.meaning: min distance between the blade and its periodic neighbours (+/- PERIODICITY along Y)
min_gap.gate: HARD GATE of geometry_qc_v1_hard: must be > 0

envelope_clearance.gate: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. A NEGATIVE value is NOT a blade collision and not a QC failure.

blade_tangential_extent.meaning: max(Y) - min(Y) of the blade section

chord.meaning: distance LE->TE of the pressure-side polyline

coordinate_frame.profile_file: .dat columns are 'xp yp xs ys' (pressure x, pressure y, suction x, suction y) in raw normalised profile units
coordinate_frame.plot_frame: x = Z = chordwise, y = Y = tangential (same frame as the .geomTurbo blade section)
coordinate_frame.plot_scale: raw profile uniformly scaled so chord = 0.06 m; all plotted distances are therefore in metres
coordinate_frame.operation: Incidence and Mach do NOT change the legacy blade geometry (verified in V1); recorded for traceability only

disclaimer: 2-D geometry views only: drawn from the real .dat / .geomTurbo coordinate data. These are NOT NUMECA/CFX meshes and NOT CFD results.
Geometry QC PASS means the frozen geometry checks (geometry_qc_v1_hard) passed. It does NOT mean the blade is aerodynamically reasonable, and it does NOT mean a mesh can be generated.
A negative envelope_clearance is a diagnostic number only, not a collision.
The exploratory ranges of this review are NOT approved production ranges.
Xthick / Tmax / Metal2 are non-dimensional parameters; they are never shown as metres.
